_meta.purpose: Machine-readable repair guide for Altitude usage violations. Keyed by the stable error CODE emitted by the validator (cli/validate.mjs). An agent that gets a violation looks up its `code` here to learn how to fix it. Human prose lives in cli/REPAIR.md.
_meta.honesty: If no Altitude element, attribute, or value expresses what a design needs, STOP. Do not invent an attribute, hard-code a color, or reach past the design system to fake it. Report the gap — an honest 'Altitude can't express X yet' is useful signal, while a faked workaround is silent drift the next person inherits.
_meta.codesAreStable: Error codes are append-only. A code's meaning never changes and it is never removed; only the human `detail` may change.

ERR_UNKNOWN_COMPONENT.title: Unknown element
ERR_UNKNOWN_COMPONENT.means: An `<al-*>` tag is not a registered Altitude custom element — a typo or a hallucinated name.
ERR_UNKNOWN_COMPONENT.fix: Use a real Altitude element. If a suggestion is offered, it is the nearest registered tag. If nothing fits, do not invent one — report the gap.

ERR_UNKNOWN_ATTRIBUTE.title: Unknown attribute
ERR_UNKNOWN_ATTRIBUTE.means: An attribute was set that the element's contract does not declare.
ERR_UNKNOWN_ATTRIBUTE.fix: Remove the attribute, or replace it with a valid one from the element's contract. slot, id, class, style, part, aria-*, data-*, and event/framework bindings are always allowed.

ERR_INVALID_ENUM.title: Invalid value
ERR_INVALID_ENUM.means: An attribute was given a value outside its allowed set.
ERR_INVALID_ENUM.fix: Set the attribute to one of its allowed values. If a suggestion is offered, it is the nearest allowed value.

ERR_TYPE_MISMATCH.title: Type mismatch
ERR_TYPE_MISMATCH.means: An attribute was given a value of the wrong type (e.g. a non-boolean where a boolean is expected).
ERR_TYPE_MISMATCH.fix: Pass a value of the type the attribute expects (boolean attributes take true/false or bare presence).
